Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 25 gallons
INCIDENT DESCRIPTION TAKEN FROM A WEB REPORT////////ON DECEMBER 27 AT ABOUT 1430 THE SECURITY GUARD PERFORMING A ROUTINE INSPECTION INSIDE THE BUILDING DISCOVERED A DIESEL SPILL IN THE DAY TAN -1. THE SECURITY GUARD REPORT TO THE UTILITIES PERSONNEL AND THEY ARRIVED QUICKLY TO THE AREA CONFIRMING THAT THE TANK WAS OVER FILLED. THE UTILITIES PERSONNEL SHUT DOWN THE VALVES BY OPENING BREAKERS 5 & 12 IN PANEL RP11 AND PROCEED TO CLEAN THE EXCESS OF FUEL. AT THIS MOMENT THE DIESEL WAS INSIDE THE BUILDING OVER A CONCRETE PAD WHERE THE DAY TANK IS LOCATED. NO DIESEL WAS FOUND OUTSIDE THE FACILITY AFTER A PERSONNEL INSPECTION. THE UTILITIES PERSONNEL PROCEED TO RUN THE EMERGENCY GENERATOR WITH OUT LOAD AND THE DAY TANK SOLENOIDS BREAKER OPENED TO BURN THE EXCESS FUEL IN THE TANK. AFTER 15 MINUTES OF RUNNING THE EMERGENCY GENERATOR, A PERSONNEL PERFORMED AN INSPECTION OUTSIDE THE BUILDING AND HE NOTICED A SPILLED MATERIAL OVER THE GROUND. THE DAY TANK WAS OVERFLOWING THE SYSTEM THOSE NOT HAVE AN OVERFLOW RETURN PUMP SO THE FUEL WAS PUMPED OUT THROW THE EXHAUST OR THE FUEL BREADING PIPE. THE FACILITIES AND UTILITIES PERSONNEL WAS QUICKLY ACTIVATED AND ARRIVE THE AREA TO CONTROL THE EMERGENCY. THE EMERGENCY GENERATOR WAS SHUT DOWN
